info.title: Inkadra API
info.description: REST API of a self-hosted Inkadra server. Board content is not here: it is a Yjs document synced over the WebSocket at /collab (see @inkadra/doc-schema).

session.name: inkadra.session_token
session.description: Session cookie set by the sign-in endpoints. Over HTTPS its name carries the `__Secure-` prefix.

bearer.description: Personal or app token (browser clipper, mobile app). Available from wave 2.

registration.description: `first-user`: nobody has an account yet and the first sign-up becomes administrator. `invite`: only invited people can sign up. `open`: anyone can sign up.

uploadMaxBytes.description: Largest file an upload may have; 0 means no limit.

peerAddress.description: Address of the TCP peer: the proxy.

request.description: The request of the caller, as the server sees it.

id.description: `public_url_https`: PUBLIC_URL uses HTTPS (warning otherwise, except on localhost). `public_url_matches_request`: the scheme and host the server sees, after the proxy headers, match PUBLIC_URL (error otherwise: secure cookies break). `proxy_trusted`: a request carrying X-Forwarded-For comes from a peer that TRUST_PROXY accepts. `database`, `queue`: as in Health. `data_dir_writable`: DATA_DIR accepts writes. `storage`: a test file can be written to and removed from the configured storage.

expected.description: What the check wanted. Always null while the instance has no accounts.

actual.description: What the check found. Always null while the instance has no accounts.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.
Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

parentBoardId.description: Null only for the project root board.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

docSchemaVersion.description: Version of the Yjs document schema (@inkadra/doc-schema) stored for this board.

breadcrumb.description: From the project root to the parent.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

url.description: Original file, served with the session cookie or token: same-origin path `/api/v1/assets/{assetId}/file`.

variants.description: WebP thumbnails, smallest first, empty until `status` is `ready`. Sizes wider than the original are skipped.

exif.description: Camera and exposure data. Location (GPS) fields are never stored.

imageAssetId.description: Preview image (og:image) copied into the project as an asset.

projectId.description: Project that will own the preview image asset.

columnId.description: Element id of a column in the board document. Omit to use "Non ordinati".

sourceUrl.description: Page the content was taken from.

get.summary: Liveness and dependency checks, for Docker and reverse proxies.
Public information the login screen and the apps need before signing in.
Installation self-check: proxy, URL, database, queue and storage.
get.description: Open to anyone while the instance has no accounts, so the person installing it can check the setup before signing up; `expected` and `actual` are then always null. Afterwards administrators only. Rate limited.

post.summary: Create an account. Allowed only while registration is `first-user` or `open`.
Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookie.
Sign out and clear the session cookie.
Create a project with its root board. The creator becomes owner.

delete.summary: Delete a project and everything in it. Owners only.

get.summary: Every board of the project, flat. Build the tree from parentBoardId.
Board metadata. The content is the Yjs document, synced over the collab WebSocket.

delete.summary: Move a board and its sub-boards to the trash. The root board cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Start a resumable upload (tus 1.0). Continue with PATCH on the Location returned.
post.description: tus creation endpoint. Send `Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0`, `Upload-Length` and `Upload-Metadata` with the base64 encoded fields of UploadMetadata. Every response about the upload, including this one, carries `Inkadra-Asset-Id`: the asset exists from the start with status `pending` and is processed once the last byte arrives. Needs `editor` on the project. Uploads left unfinished are removed after 24 hours.

201.description: Upload created; Location header points to it

413.description: Larger than the instance limit (see Instance.limits)

head.summary: Offset of a resumable upload (tus 1.0), to resume after an interruption.

delete.summary: Cancel an unfinished upload (tus termination extension).

get.summary: The original file. Supports `Range`; `?download=1` asks the browser to save it.
get.description: Types a browser could run as a page (HTML, SVG, XML) are always sent as attachments, with a sandbox Content-Security-Policy.

get.summary: A WebP thumbnail, without any metadata of the original.

post.summary: Read title, description and image of a public web page, for a link card.
post.description: The server fetches the page itself, only over http(s) on public addresses, with a size and time limit. Needs `editor` on the project. The image becomes an asset of the project.

400.description: Invalid address, or the page could not be fetched

post.summary: Save an image, a link or a text to a board, from the clipper or the share sheet.
